result.title: Scaling RNA Foundation Models through Iterative Refinement
result.summary: Biological function in RNA is encoded across scales, from local sequence motifs to long-range structural dependencies. Conventional RNA foundation models couple parameter capacity and inference depth within a fixed architecture, prescribing a fixed computation graph for each inference. Here we present Eco-RNA, an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model that makes inference depth adjustable through learned iterative refinement. Its shared, input-conditioned Transformer core refines sequence representations through repeated application. The iteration count is selected after training and controls effective depth at fixed model parameters. We train across recurrent depths with masked reconstruction, state regularization, and a one-sided loss that anchors deeper reconstruction to a shallow reference. On the 70-assay RNAGym fitness benchmark, increasing refinement from one to four iterations raises aggregate absolute Spearman correlation from 0.242 to 0.286, with the gain retained through eight iterations. At four iterations, Eco-RNA surpasses the current SOTA Evo 2 40B on all three aggregate fitness metrics despite 500x fewer parameters. Its iteration configurations advance the compute-performance Pareto frontier among the evaluated models. It also outperforms the evaluated baselines in non-coding RNA family classification, RNA secondary-structure prediction, and chemical probing profile prediction. These results establish internal inference computation as an effective scaling dimension for RNA foundation models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 80M 参数的 RNA 基础模型 Eco-RNA，用共享的、输入条件化的 Transformer 核心反复精化序列表示，训练后可选择迭代次数以在固定参数下控制有效推理深度。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属生物序列领域，但其「迭代精化即缩放维度」、跨递归深度训练、「深重构锚定浅参考」的单侧损失与状态正则，可能为 LVR 的循环生成 latent 状态、深度泛化与监督设计提供可供核查的线索。
